seoTitle: Syed Raza Mumtaz | Network Architect & Technical Leader
seoDescription: Professional experience, technical leadership, education and certifications for Syed Raza Mumtaz, Principal Network Architect and Technical Leader.

hero.heading: Syed Raza Mumtaz
hero.introduction: Principal Network Architect and Technical Leader with more than 20 years of experience designing, validating and operating carrier-grade, cloud, data-center and mission-critical networks.

profile: Principal network architect and technical leader with a record of shaping carrier-grade, cloud, data-center, optical and low-latency networks across enterprise and mission-critical environments.
Brings together deep engineering expertise, strategic presales leadership and trusted customer advisory to turn complex requirements into clear, commercially viable solutions.
Leads architecture from discovery through validation and delivery while building capable teams, improving engineering discipline and keeping business outcomes at the centre of technical decisions.
expertise: IP/MPLS, BGP, OSPF and traffic engineering
Ethernet, dark fibre, DWDM/CWDM and GPON/FTTx
High availability, resiliency and disaster recovery
Multi-vendor integration, PoCs, IVV&T and testing

experience.title: Manager, Sales Engineering (Wholesale)
summary: Lead end-to-end solution architecture for a multi-country enterprise network connecting more than 1,000 locations across the Caribbean and Latin America.
Set the presales technical strategy for strategic accounts, translating business priorities and service objectives into resilient regional network designs.
Develop engineering capability through mentorship, technical governance, disciplined reporting and product-improvement leadership.

experience.title: Senior Sales Engineer (Wholesale)
summary: Architected regional and multinational connectivity across wireless, terrestrial and subsea infrastructure for carrier and enterprise customers.
Led complex RFP and RFI responses, shaped solution strategy and advised customers on architectures aligned with operational, financial and growth objectives.

experience.title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales
summary: Designed dark-fibre, DWDM/CWDM, GPON, cloud and data-center connectivity for demanding enterprise and carrier environments.
Owned technical discovery, solution presentations, RFP responses and implementation strategy across sales, revenue-assurance and delivery teams.

experience.title: Managing Director
summary: Directed renovation and construction engagements from design and procurement through execution, quality control and client handover.
Managed licensed trades, business development, financial performance and customer relationships, combining practical delivery with commercial accountability.

experience.title: Senior Engineer, Hybrid Cloud & Data Center Infrastructure
summary: Directed connectivity and hybrid-cloud operations for a global advertising exchange supporting latency-sensitive, real-time bidding workloads.
Improved load-balancing, availability and network performance across distributed colocation and cloud infrastructure.

experience.title: Senior Network Design Engineer
summary: Advanced network architecture and R&D for Telesat's low-Earth-orbit satellite program, connecting space-based innovation with carrier-grade engineering.
Led control- and data-plane design using open-source SDN/NFV frameworks and built constellation simulators and reusable R&D testbeds.
Translated research into proof-of-concept designs, customer demonstrations and network product and service definitions.

experience.title: Technical Operations Specialist, Private Cloud Engineering
summary: Operated multi-tenant cloud unified communications and Cisco data-center infrastructure, including business-critical Hosted Collaboration Solution environments.
Designed and delivered UCaaS, UCCX and HCS Expressway proofs of concept that helped enterprise customers validate adoption paths.

experience.title: Manager, Operations, Military SATCOM
summary: Provided technical and operational leadership for mission-critical military satellite communications supporting the UAE Armed Forces.
Led an 18-engineer, 24x7 Network Operations Center responsible for service availability, incident command and operational readiness.
Strengthened automation, verification and validation, Tier-3 troubleshooting and compliance with MILSATCOM and information-security standards.

experience.title: Bitstream Network Engineer / Tier-3 Internet Core
summary: Operated and optimized a carrier-scale IP/MPLS Internet backbone together with GPON, FTTx and next-generation access networks.
Improved network performance and resilience through BGP/OSPF traffic engineering, interoperability testing, capacity planning and disaster-recovery engineering.

experience.title: Network Analyst
summary: Designed low-latency, high-availability trading networks for financial institutions where reliability and response time were business-critical.
Established the resilient architecture and redundancy practices that became the foundation for later carrier and mission-critical network leadership.

certifications: Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert - CCIE Service Provider #36259
MEF Carrier Ethernet Certified Professional - MEF-CECP
